ig_caption:
Thu, Nov 19: 6,949 deer reported statewide (4,591 antlered, 2,358 antlerless). Season total: 184,761.

Three counties reported more antlerless than antlered deer Thursday: Otsego (57% of 56 new), Kalkaska (57% of 49) and Hillsdale (52% of 128), while statewide new reports ran 66% antlered.
